summary: Valuence Merger Corp. I, a blank check company, filed an 8-K to report that its board approved a one-month extension to consummate an initial business combination, pushing the deadline from September 3, 2026 to October 3, 2026. This is the fifth of ten permitted extensions. The company deposited $13,897.14 into its trust account to fund this extension. This routine SPAC extension notification is not a special-situation event and does not qualify for any other category.
